name: ratchet
description: Zero-dependency polyglot quality ratchet & completion-hook guardrails (.ratchet.json) for AI coding.

interface.shortDescription: Freeze legacy debt & block AI regressions

defaultPrompt: Run /ratchet init to freeze current baselines.
Run /ratchet check and fix any regressions.
